title: Muscovite gave over 5 million rubles after the "nephew"
text:
A resident of Moscow gave scams over five million rubles. This has been reported by Ren TV with reference to the source.
According to the dialogue, the scammers introduced herself as a 51 -year -old woman with a letter staff and in a conversation seduced her personal data. After that, other “experts” said its funds were accused of being in danger.
In order to save their savings, the victim repeatedly withdrew the money from the accounts in banks, then she gave the courier, pronounced from the code that was thought to be the word grandson.
After a while, the woman of friends learned about the situation and persuaded her to contact the police. In total, the scammers seduced 5.5 million rubles from Muscovite.
Earlier, another Muscovite almost gave 50 million rubles attackers. FSB officers, Viking people threatened their retirement and asked for money transfer, but she was blocked by a girl at that time out to rearrange the car.
